questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Abundant
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Abundant
questions.solution: The correct answer is: Ample. The word "Abundant" refers to something existing in large quantities or being plentiful. The meanings of the other words are: Scarce: Insufficient or in short supply; Barren: Unproductive or unable to produce; Difficult: Hard to do or understand.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. One who does not show response to good or bad
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
One who does not show response to good or bad
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Stoic. 

Meaning: A stoic is a person who can endure pain or hardship without showing their feelings or complaining.

Usage: When used in a sentence, it implies that the person remains calm and unemotional in the face of adversity.

questions.question: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence. (O) as it was the last one of the evening (P) the city bus was overcrowded (Q) and this gave an opportunity (R) to the pickpockets (S) to try their skill
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.
(O) as it was the last one of the evening
(P) the city bus was overcrowded
(Q) and this gave an opportunity
(R) to the pickpockets
(S) to try their skill
questions.solution: The correct answer is: POQRS. The sentence begins with the subject and main clause (P) "the city bus was overcrowded," followed by the reason (O) "as it was the last one of the evening." This situation leads to the consequence (Q) "and this gave an opportunity," which is then specified by (R) "to the pickpockets" and (S) "to try their skill." The logical flow is: The bus was crowded (P) because it was the last one (O), which provided a chance (Q) for pickpockets (R) to steal (S).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word. If you want to be a good detective, it helps to have an inquisitive nature.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

If you want to be a good detective, it helps to have an inquisitive nature.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Disinterested. 

The meaning of "inquisitive" is having or showing an interest in learning things; curious.

The meaning of "disinterested" is having no interest in something; indifferent.

The relationship between them is that they are opposites; "inquisitive" implies curiosity and interest, while "disinterested" implies a lack of interest or indifference.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice. The meal was not prepared by us.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.
The meal was not prepared by us.

options.text: We had not prepare the meal.
options.html: We had not prepare the meal.

options.text: We did not prepare the meal.
options.html: We did not prepare the meal.

options.text: We did not preparing the meal.
options.html: We did not preparing the meal.

questions.solution: The correct answer is: We did not prepare the meal. The conversion is from Passive to Active. In the passive voice, the subject receives the action (The meal was not prepared by us), whereas in the active voice, the subject performs the action (We did not prepare the meal).

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice. The homework must be done by you.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.
The homework must be done by you.

options.text: You should have done the homework.
options.html: You should have done the homework.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: You must do the homework.
The conversion is Passive to Active.
Explanation: In the given passive voice sentence, "The homework must be done by you," the object "homework" is being acted upon. When converting to active voice, "you" becomes the subject performing the action, and "must do" indicates the necessity of the action.

questions.question: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence. (a) the use of animal research (b) throughout the past century (c) and it continues to be used to understand many diseases (d) has been of considerable importance (e) in the field of scientific and medical advancements
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.
(a) the use of animal research
(b) throughout the past century
(c) and it continues to be used to understand many diseases
(d) has been of considerable importance
(e) in the field of scientific and medical advancements
questions.solution: The correct answer is: ADEBC. The sentence begins with the subject (a) "the use of animal research," followed by the verb phrase (d) "has been of considerable importance." This importance is then contextualized (e) "in the field of scientific and medical advancements." The sentence continues with a temporal marker (b) "throughout the past century" and concludes with a coordinating clause (c) "and it continues to be used to understand many diseases," resulting in a logical and grammatically correct structure.

questions.question: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct logical sequence. A. These can turn around to track stars with the rotation of Earth. B. Observatories are places to study place. C. They are mostly built on the mountain tops. D. Telescopes are placed in the dome-shaped roof of the building.
questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct logical sequence.
A. These can turn around to track stars with the rotation of Earth.
B. Observatories are places to study place.
C. They are mostly built on the mountain tops.
D. Telescopes are placed in the dome-shaped roof of the building.
questions.solution: The correct answer is: BCDA. The paragraph begins by defining observatories (B), which introduces the main subject. Sentence (C) follows by describing their typical location on mountain tops. Sentence (D) then specifies what is inside these buildings (telescopes in dome-shaped roofs). Finally, (A) explains a specific function of "these" (the telescopes mentioned in D), completing the logical flow from the general definition to specific equipment and its function.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word. Elisabeth stood at the piano, which did nothing to allay his anxiety.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Elisabeth stood at the piano, which did nothing to allay his anxiety.
questions.solution: The correct answer is: aggravate. "Allay" means to diminish or soothe anxiety, whereas "aggravate" means to make it worse or more intense. The meanings of the other words are: Mitigate: To make less severe; Simplify: To make easier; Mollify: To soothe or appease.

questions.question: Identify the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Scary
questions.questionHtml:
Identify the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
Scary
questions.solution: The correct answer is: comforting.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The meaning of the word "Scary" means causing fear or alarm.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The meaning of the word "Comforting" means providing solace or a sense of ease.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               They are opposite in meaning because something that is comforting alleviates fear, unlike something scary which induces it.

questions.solution: The correct answer is: Demented. The word "Berserk" refers to a person who is out of control with anger or excitement, behaving in a wild or frenzied manner. The meanings of the other words are: Absurd: Wildly unreasonable or illogical; Stubborn: Unyielding or determined; Lazy: Unwilling to work or use energy.

questions.solution: The correct answer is: highly. The word "highly" is used to describe an increase to a great degree or level, which is the most appropriate fit for describing the rise in "pollution levels." The meanings of the other words are: Slowly: At a low speed or pace; Primarily: For the most part or mainly; Chiefly: Above all or essentially.
